assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks
The diagnosis code for transient ischemic attacks is G45.9
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The CPT code for the service is 93247
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the relationship between the patient's palpitations and lightheadedness and the underlying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
